scope: TCP SYN classification to an exact AirDrop DNS-SD endpoint

result.confirmed: lwIP emitted five checksum-valid TCP SYNs to the exact DNS-SD endpoint and espDrop submitted them in guarded common windows. No inbound TCP segment was decoded. The native Mac timed out to the same endpoint despite a reachable AWDL neighbor entry.
result.notConfirmed: The ESP transmit callback's protocol-specific counter did not classify the driver-normalized returned frame; its generic callback reported all data frames successful. No receiver-ready positive control was available.
result.nextFocus: Repeat with a receiver proven reachable from native macOS immediately before the ESP run, then compare SYN/SYN-ACK behavior. Investigate BLE wake/discoverability state if the native control remains unreachable.
